concept.title: Accessibility checklist
concept.shortdesc: When prioritizing accessibility, you should meet the following criteria:

conbody.p:
When prioritizing accessibility, you should meet the following criteria:
Every <image>has descriptive <alt> text
<fig> elements include <title>
Table cells are not empty (use "N/A" or "—" if no value)
Colour is not the only means of conveying information
Link text is descriptive and meaningful out of context (avoid “click here” or vague phrases).
Headings (<title> and section <title>) follow a logical hierarchy and are not used only for visual styling.
Lists use <ul>, <ol>, or <dl> for semantic structure instead of paragraph‑level workarounds.
Tables and figures are referenced explicitly in surrounding text so readers know what comes next.
